Team / partners —

We need to lock down a few platform details for the July 20 webinar (Acme Analytics customers). Key questions:
- Passcode gating: prefer to gate on the ON24 registration confirmation (passcode in confirmation email) or use Zoom Events passcode? Any downstream friction for registrants or for our Ops team?
- Registration form fields: we need a required corporate email field, and two checkboxes (one for marketing opt-in, one for recording consent). Any restrictions on checkbox wording?
- Recording/transcript: Acme asked for recording delivered within 48 hours and the transcript exported. Are there compliance flags for auto-record + export?
- Streaming test window: propose Fri July 16 10:00-10:30 PT for a full end-to-end test (slides, Q&A, recording).

Marissa / Tessa / ON24 / Zoom / Ari — please reply with feasibility and any platform-specific steps. I attached the latest run-of-show draft for reference.

Thanks,
Grace

Quick thoughts from ops:
- Strong preference for ON24-managed passcode. Less manual work for Ops and attendees get the passcode in confirmation which reduces join friction. ON24 can merge the passcode into the email template.
- Form fields: corporate email required (we'll validate domain pattern), then two checkboxes: "Yes, I agree to receive marketing communications" (not pre-checked) and "I consent to being recorded and to receive the recording" (not pre-checked). Legal prefers explicit consent wording; I attached an updated run-of-show with the wording in the notes.
- Recording: auto-record on the ON24 console. We'll request transcript and recording export from ON24. Acme's 48-hour ask is tight but doable if ON24 pushes the export right after the recording.

Attaching: event_run_of_show_v3.xlsx (includes email templates).

Marissa

Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Finalize passcode gating & registration opt-ins for July 20 webinar

Hi Grace / team —

Confirmed: we support passcode gating at the confirmation-email level. Implementation notes:
- Create a "Custom Passcode" on the event settings (we can auto-generate or accept your value).
- Passcode max length = 20 chars; recommended pattern is alphanumeric with hyphen allowed.
- Use the merge tag {{confirmation_passcode}} in your confirmation email template — this will populate per registrant.
- For checkbox consent fields, use the "Custom Field" type with the field label and type = checkbox; do not pre-check. We recommend adding a link to your privacy policy in the label.

Note on recording delivery: we can generate the recording and the auto-caption .vtt within 24 hours in most cases. For guaranteed 48-hour delivery please enable "Expedited Processing" (one-time fee) — see attached screenshot for where to toggle.

Attachment: on24-passcode-setup-screenshot.png

Let us know if you'd like us to pre-create the passcode and template updates — we can do that by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
ON24 Support

- Speaker release: we need signed speaker consent for recording and repurpose. I attached a short privacy note (privacy_note.pdf) with the clause we'd like included.

If ON24 can support expedited processing and a push to our S3, that meets our SLA. Otherwise Acme will accept the 48-hour window if Redwood confirms the pull workflow.

Ari

Thanks — feeling good about this.
